integrity: The graphical-zonotope and Boolean-lattice constructions, classical matrix-tree theorem, and unpunctured-cube literature are credited. No independent external mathematical audit or formal certification is claimed.
limitations: Two spectral factors are given by finite-order integer continuants rather than general radical roots; equivalent evaluated graph-theoretic formulas may exist under alternative terminology. Only finite sample comparisons were independently computed; these do not replace the all-dimensional proof.
title: Laplacian spectrum and spanning-tree complexity of cycle graphical zonotopes
